name: Samper del Salz (Spain)
description: Yellow field with red stripes along the upper and lower edges, charged at the centre with a red lozenge bearing a yellow willow tree and crossed keys.
history: Municipal flag of Samper del Salz; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: willow tree with crossed keys on the lozenge
